objective: Add a standards-aligned exact-binary client projection path without moving Artifact standing, provider delivery, or external-effect authority into Runtime.

externalStandards.contract: Tool results support EmbeddedResource and ResourceLink; binary ResourceContents use base64 blob plus URI and MIME type.
externalStandards.decision: Use EmbeddedResource for bounded exact binary projection; do not invent an Artifact-specific transport protocol.

externalStandards.contract: Resource metadata includes URI, name/title, MIME type and size; resource contents distinguish text from binary blob.
externalStandards.decision: Preserve digest/size/media-type identity in structured content and use a stable non-file authority URI.

legos.label: WorkspaceBinaryProjectionContract
legos.contract: workspace.file projects one exact digest-bound regular Workspace file as an MCP EmbeddedResource blob with structured identity metadata; no external effect and no Artifact registration.

legos.label: WorkspaceBinaryPathAndDigestAuthority
legos.contract: Reuse the descriptor-bound Workspace path authority used by workspace.read/content; require expectedDigest and a bounded whole-file read.

legos.label: MediaTypeContract
legos.contract: Caller supplies a bounded declared mediaType used only as projection metadata; Runtime proves bytes/digest/size, not semantic conformance to the media type.

legos.label: McpEmbeddedResourceAdapter
legos.contract: Return ResourceContents::BlobResourceContents using a non-authority ordivon-workspace URI and exact structured metadata.

legos.label: JobArtifactBinaryProjection
legos.contract: Add artifact.content as the binary sibling of artifact.read while preserving jobId+artifactId Registry authority and digest/length revalidation.

legos.label: LargeObjectResourceLink
legos.contract: For files too large for one embedded MCP result, prefer MCP ResourceLink/resources semantics or a mature external object carrier; do not invent chunked Artifact transport prematurely.

legos.label: ArtifactTransportExternalization
legos.contract: Keep capabilities/artifact transport/mailbox code quarantined or externalized; binary client projection is Runtime observation, not Artifact delivery standing.

acceptance: binary bytes including NUL round-trip through MCP blob
structured metadata binds workspaceId, relativePath, digest, mediaType and byteLength
generated tool catalog and docs are updated
nonGoals: Artifact standing or semantic media validation
